verses.1: And these are the children of Noah. Their names were Ham and Japheth. They had sons after the flood.
verses.2: The sons of Yefet were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yavan, Tubal, Meshek, and Tiras.
verses.3: And the sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.4: And the sons of Javan were Elisa and Tarshish, along with their cities and rulers.
verses.5: These people separated from each other in their own lands. Each went back to his own family in their own countries.
verses.6: And the sons of Ham: Cush, Mesir, Put, and Kenan.
verses.7: And the sons of Kush: Saba, Hivila, Sabtah, Ra’ma, Sabtkaa. And the sons of Ra’ma: Shaba and Dadan.
verses.8: And when Nimrod was born, he began to be a ruler over the land.
verses.9: He was a powerful ruler before Jehovah. Therefore, it is said, “A powerful ruler stood before Jehovah.”
verses.10: And the beginning of his reign was in Babylon. His reign lasted for many years, including those in Erech and Akkad. He ruled over all the lands of Shinar.
verses.11: From that land, Ashur came out and built his cities, as well as their streets and all the other structures there.
verses.12: And Resen, between Ninveh and Kalakh, is the great city.
verses.13: And Egypt gave birth to children, as well as women and men.
verses.14: And the pots and the pans that were taken out from there by the Philistines, and also the coverings for them.
verses.15: And Canaan became the father of Sidon and Hekt.
verses.16: And the Yebusi, and the Amori, and the Gergeshi.
verses.17: And the Hivv and the Arki and the Sinni.
verses.18: And the Arwadi, and the Tzmeri, and the Chamati; then they were destroyed from among the Canaanites.
verses.19: And the border of the Canaanites extended from there towards Gherara, all the way to Azah, then towards Sdoma and Amorah. It also included land and islands, all the way to Lashah.
verses.20: These are the sons of Ham, who live in their own lands and in their own countries.
verses.21: And for that reason, he also became the father of all the children of Eber. He was my brother, the great one.
verses.22: The sons of Shem were Elam, Ashur, Arpacshad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.23: And the sons of Aram were Uzziel, Hul, Geter, and Mash.
verses.24: And Arpachshad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Eber.
verses.25: And after him were born two sons. The name of the first son was Pelag, because in his time the land was divided into separate regions. And the name of his brother was Yaktan.
verses.26: And he would reduce the size of his brother, and also of Shalef and Hacharmawet and Yarah.
verses.27: And Ederam, and Uzzal, and Diklah.
verses.28: And Eohol, and Abimalek, and Shabaa.
verses.29: And Ophir, and Chivila, and Yovav – all these are the sons of Yaktan.
verses.30: And their seat was set up from the mountain of Sheba, at the foot of the mountain of Kedem.
verses.31: These are the sons of Sem, for their wives, so that they may live in their own lands and in their own nations.
verses.32: These are the descendants of Noah’s sons, who were born in their own lands. From these people, the lands were separated after the flood.
